name: Cinchophen

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Germany and Italy, first in 1991 — for liver harm

summary: Cinchophen was removed from the market in Germany and Italy starting in 1991 due to harm to the liver [3]. A small computer model, not tests on humans, produced scores of 78 in the high band for liver risk and 9 in the low band for heart risk [M]. These computer ratings serve as estimated indicators rather than direct clinical measurements in people [M].
